name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Jorgen sends trusted operatives across Stormwind with a sealed note for Elling Trias. From the Valley of Heroes to Trias' Cheese in the Trade District, the delivery carries the search for the missing diplomat.

sections.title: A Discreet Delivery
sections.body: After the first inquiries into the diplomat's disappearance, Jorgen asks trusted operatives to keep silent and carry a sealed note across Stormwind. It is bound for Trias' Cheese in the Trade District, not a barracks or magistrate's office. As concern spreads beyond the palace, the handoff avoids the usual guard channels.

sections.title: Behind the Shopfront
sections.body: Elling Trias is a jovial and hardworking cheesemonger at Trias' Cheese, and a respected merchant. His ties to Jorgen and his own contacts reach beyond the shop. Once Jorgen's note arrives, Trias quietly takes the search for the missing diplomat into his hands.

faq.answer: Elling Trias is a respected merchant who runs Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District. He shares a history with Jorgen and has contacts for delicate matters.

faq.q: Why does Jorgen tell me to keep quiet?
faq.answer: Jorgen demands silence because the diplomat's disappearance is a state secret. Word could stir panic or alert whoever orchestrated the abduction, revealing that an investigation is underway.

faq.q: Where can I find Trias' Cheese?
faq.answer: Trias' Cheese is in Stormwind City's Trade District, along the main avenues among merchants and craftsmen.

faq.q: What is in the sealed note to Elling?
faq.answer: Jorgen's sealed note tells Elling Trias about the missing diplomat and asks him to use his contacts and underground ears to find tracks the usual authorities cannot trace.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The royal court keeps the diplomat's identity secret at this stage. The secrecy and concern point to someone of immense political importance to the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: Why would the investigation use a cheesemonger instead of the city guard?
faq.answer: The city guard is bound by protocol, jurisdiction, and political ties. Elling Trias can reach street whispers and quiet contacts beyond the soldiers' reach.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may suspect Trias' Cheese is more than a dairy storefront. Its owner keeps quiet contacts well beyond the Trade District.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the quiet search for the missing envoy reveals subtle vulnerabilities in Stormwind's leadership.
